items.question: Is the alliance real?
items.answer: The alliance is fictional and intentionally humorous. The shark conservation allocation is real, tracked, and reported publicly.

items.question: Does membership protect me from sharks?
items.answer: No. It offers no marine protection whatsoever. It does, however, help protect actual sharks from humans, which is the statistically more relevant problem.

items.question: Where does the money actually go?
items.answer: Each certificate contributes to a conservation allocation we track and report publicly. As allocations are completed, we publish the recipient organizations and the amounts allocated.

items.question: Why sharks?
items.answer: Because sharks have a PR problem they did not create. Humans kill roughly 100 million sharks a year. Sharks kill very few humans. The imbalance is embarrassing.

items.question: Will I receive a certificate?
items.answer: Yes. A personalized digital certificate with your name, membership tier, and an air of surprisingly official diplomatic recognition. Delivered instantly.

items.question: Can I give this as a gift?
items.answer: Absolutely. Protected Friend Status is the most popular gift option. People frame it, share it, and nobody can explain why it works so well.

faqPage.label: FAQ
faqPage.title: Reasonable questions. Excellent answers.
faqPage.subtitle: For sensible humans who want to know what they’re buying, where the money goes, and whether sharks can read certificates.

items.question: Is this legally useful?
items.answer: No. It is not a legal document, safety guarantee, diplomatic credential, or anti-bite instrument. It is official-looking joke paperwork with a real conservation allocation behind it.

items.question: Will sharks respect it?
items.answer: Almost certainly not. Sharks have not ratified the paperwork and are unlikely to attend the meeting. The certificate protects sharks from humans more than humans from sharks.

items.question: Where does the real money go?
items.answer: Conservation allocations are funded from Shark Human Alliance revenue. We track them internally and publish recipient organizations and allocation details once public allocation reports are issued. Planned recipients are not formal partners unless we expressly say so.

items.question: When do conservation allocations start, and how will they be reported?
items.answer: We publish public allocation reports once allocations are actually completed. This page and our social channels will show recipient organizations and reported amounts as they happen.

items.question: Are these formal partner organizations?
items.answer: Not unless we explicitly say so. We list planned recipients first and only describe an organization as a formal partner or confirmed recipient when that is actually true.

items.question: How much does each certificate cost?
items.answer: Protected Friend is $4. Non-Snack Recognition is $19. Shark-Free Zone is $99. The Alliance does not negotiate, mostly because nobody asked.

items.question: Will I receive a certificate immediately?
items.answer: Yes. You receive a personalized digital certificate. If you provide an email address, we also send the delivery link by email.

items.question: What do I receive immediately after purchase?
items.answer: A success page with your certificate preview and a download link. If you entered an email address, we also send the certificate link to that inbox.

items.question: Can I access my certificate later?
items.answer: Yes, if you provide an email address during checkout. If you skip email, the certificate is only available for immediate download after purchase and the link is not stored for later retrieval.

items.question: Can I buy this as a gift?
items.answer: Yes. You can buy a certificate as a gift and enter the recipient details during checkout. If you want reliable later access, include an email address in the purchase flow.

items.question: Why sharks?
items.answer: Because sharks have a PR problem they did not create. Humans kill roughly 100 million sharks a year. Sharks kill very few humans. The imbalance is embarrassing.

items.question: Is this a donation or a product purchase?
items.answer: It is a purchase of a humorous digital product, not a direct charitable donation. A conservation allocation is funded from Shark Human Alliance revenue on our side, and it is not tax-deductible.

items.question: Is this a charity?
items.answer: No. Shark Human Alliance is a playful digital product project operated by JEEL Wekeza s.r.o. Part of each purchase is allocated to shark conservation and reported publicly. You are buying a digital product, not making a direct charitable donation.

items.question: What size is the certificate?
items.answer: Certificates are optimized for A4 or US Letter download and printing.

items.question: Can I print it?
items.answer: Yes. Certificates are designed for A4 and US Letter printing. For best results, print at 100% / Actual Size and use paper dramatic enough to respect the paperwork.

items.question: Can I make it private?
items.answer: Yes. Public registry listing is optional. If you do not opt in, the certificate record stays private and is used only for delivery, verification, and support.

items.question: Can I use a fake name?
items.answer: Yes, within reason. Nicknames, office titles, and joke names are fine. The Bureau draws the line at abusive, unlawful, or impersonation-style entries — even sharks have standards, allegedly.

items.question: Is this suitable for offices?
items.answer: Yes. Shark-Free Zone is built for offices, cafes, studios, meeting rooms, and other places where sharks are not expected but paperwork still improves morale.

items.question: Is the Wanted poster free?
items.answer: Yes. The Wanted poster is free to generate and share. If the situation becomes administratively serious, you can close the case with a Protected Friend certificate.

items.question: Do I need to fill out Form FIN-1 manually?
items.answer: No. Form FIN-1 is processed automatically during checkout. The Bureau stamps it on your behalf. Other forms are handled internally and rarely escape.

impact.label: Our Impact
impact.title: Where the money actually goes.
impact.brandLine: Sharks deserve better PR. And real protection.
impact.subtitle: The paperwork is fictional. The shark conservation allocation is real. We track every sale, publish allocations, and do not call a recipient a confirmed partner until money has actually moved.
impact.splitDescription: Certificate prices are fixed at $4, $19, and $99. Lower tiers carry proportionally higher payment processing and operating costs. The conservation portion of each sale is tracked and reported here through public allocation reports.
impact.splitProtectedText: $1 from every Protected Friend sale goes to shark conservation. Small certificate. Real contribution.
impact.splitNonsnackText: $12 from every Non-Snack sale goes to conservation. The certificate is theatrical. The allocation is not.
impact.splitBusinessText: $70 from every business certification goes to conservation. If you’re putting it on the wall, it should earn its place there.
impact.splitOpsText: The remainder covers the less aquatic work: payment processing, hosting, certificate rendering, admin, and the creative maintenance of a joke that has somehow become paperwork. The main product is the certificate and the suspiciously official joke. The conservation allocation is the real, tracked part that gives the paperwork a reason to exist.
impact.firstTargetText: Before we publish the first allocation report, the immediate goal is a clear $500 conservation allocation. The recipient and receipt will be published before we call it completed.
impact.firstTargetStatusShort: Planned first target: Shark Trust, pending the first public allocation.
impact.firstTargetStatusNote: Conservation allocations are tracked internally until the $500 threshold; no allocation is reported as completed before the receipt is published here.

termsPage.title: Terms & Purchase Conditions
termsPage.intro: These terms explain how ordering, immediate digital delivery, support, complaints, corrections and refund handling work for Shark Human Alliance certificates. This page is meant to make the purchase process clearer and less mysterious than most shark paperwork.

operator.title: 1. Operator
operator.body: This website is operated by JEEL Wekeza s.r.o., Company ID (IČO): 07969694, registered office Radlická 663/28, 150 00 Prague, Czech Republic. The company is registered in the Commercial Register maintained by the Municipal Court in Prague, file no. C 310737. If you need help with an order, delivery issue, file defect, duplicate payment, or complaint, contact us at sharkhumanalliance@gmail.com.

products.title: 2. What is being sold
products.body: The website sells digital, personalized certificates and related digital assets within the Shark Human Alliance project. The certificate is symbolic, humorous, and not legally binding. It is not a safety guarantee, diplomatic credential, official certification, insurance product, or marine authority document. Unless explicitly stated otherwise on the product page, the product is delivered digitally and no physical framed certificate is shipped. Current conservation allocations are described on the Impact page, including the amount allocated per tier and the organizations currently listed as planned recipients.

ordering.title: 3. Order, payment, and contract formation
ordering.body: To place an order, choose a certificate tier, enter the requested details, review the price and purchase summary, confirm the Terms & Purchase Conditions, confirm immediate digital delivery, and complete payment through the checkout flow. Card payments are processed by Stripe. The order is treated as placed once payment is successfully confirmed or, for a valid free promo checkout, once the checkout flow confirms completion.

privacy.title: 4. Personal data and legal basis
privacy.body: To issue and deliver the certificate, we process the submitted name, dedication text, delivery email where provided, gift recipient email where provided, and related order identifiers. This processing is carried out to perform the contract and deliver the requested digital certificate. Dedication text is moderated before acceptance and may be rejected if it contains unlawful, abusive, defamatory, misleading, impersonation-style, or contact-style content. More detail is provided in the Privacy Policy.

registry.title: 5. Public registry
registry.body: The public Diplomatic Registry displays only records for which the customer actively opted in during checkout or later made the record public through record controls. If no registry opt-in is given, the record remains private and is not returned by the public registry endpoint. Record visibility can later be hidden, and an erasure request can be initiated, through the private record controls linked from the certificate access flow.

moderation.title: 6. Dedication moderation
moderation.body: Dedication text is user-submitted content. We reserve the right to reject, shorten, remove, or refuse to issue content that is unlawful, abusive, defamatory, threatening, misleading, or otherwise damaging to third parties, public order, or the Shark Human Alliance brand presentation. If moderation blocks the submitted text, the order cannot proceed until acceptable wording is provided.

delivery.title: 7. Delivery and access
delivery.body: Certificates are generated digitally after successful payment or successful free promo checkout. Delivery is provided through the success page and, if an email address is provided, delivery details may also be sent by email. If no email address is provided, the certificate should be downloaded immediately from the success page because the link may not be stored for later retrieval. If delivery fails, contact support and include the order details available to you.

digitalContent.title: 8. Immediate digital delivery and withdrawal right
digitalContent.body: Because the certificate is personalized digital content made from details you provide, the checkout asks for express consent to immediate digital delivery before the usual withdrawal period expires. If you give that consent and acknowledge the related withdrawal consequences, the certificate can be generated and made available immediately after successful payment. This does not affect your statutory rights in case of defective digital content, failed delivery, duplicate charge, or another issue caused by us.

conservation.title: 9. Conservation disclaimer
conservation.body: Conservation allocations are funded from Shark Human Alliance revenue. You are purchasing a digital product, not making a direct charitable donation, and the purchase is not tax-deductible as a charitable gift. Allocations are tracked internally and reported publicly once public allocation reports are issued. Planned recipients are not sponsors, endorsers, confirmed recipients, or formal partners unless expressly confirmed.

complaints.title: 10. Complaints and technical issues
complaints.body: If the delivered file is defective, the certificate cannot be downloaded, the wrong tier is generated, a payment appears duplicated, or another technical or payment-related issue occurs, contact support without unnecessary delay and include the order details if available. We will review the issue and propose a practical resolution, such as re-delivery, correction, replacement, refund where appropriate, or another suitable remedy.

refunds.title: 11. Refunds and corrections
refunds.body: Because the product is a personalized digital item, refund and correction requests are handled individually based on the specific issue and applicable consumer law. If there is a duplicate charge, technical delivery failure, or a defect caused on our side, contact us and we will review the request promptly. If the certificate contains a mistake caused by submitted input data, we still encourage you to contact us and we will try to help with a practical correction.

contact.title: 12. Contact
contact.body: For support, complaint handling, withdrawal or correction questions, or purchase questions, contact sharkhumanalliance@gmail.com. Please include the order email, Stripe checkout reference if available, certificate holder name, and a short description of the issue so the Bureau can find the file without pretending sharks have searchable handwriting.

cookiePolicyPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicyPage.intro: This page explains how Shark Human Alliance uses cookies and similar technologies to keep the website working, support checkout and, with your consent, measure traffic through analytics.

whatAreCookies.title: 1. What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember basic settings, keep sessions secure and, where allowed, measure traffic and performance.

categories.title: 2. Which categories do we use?
categories.body: We use necessary cookies for website functionality, language handling, security, checkout and payment processing. With your consent, we also use analytics cookies through Google Analytics 4 to understand traffic and improve the website.

retention.title: 3. How long do we keep cookie preferences?
retention.body: Your cookie preference is stored for up to 180 days unless you change or delete it sooner. Individual third-party cookies may use their own retention periods within the limits of applicable law and provider settings.

thirdParties.title: 4. Which third parties are involved?
thirdParties.body: Our website may rely on Google Analytics 4 for traffic measurement and Stripe for secure payment processing. Stripe-related cookies and storage may be necessary to complete checkout and protect payment security.

changeConsent.title: 5. How can you change or withdraw consent?
changeConsent.body: You can change your cookie preferences at any time by using the “Cookies settings” link in the footer. If you choose necessary cookies only, analytics cookies remain disabled.

controller.title: 6. Who is the controller?
controller.body: The website is operated by JEEL Wekeza s.r.o. If you have questions about cookies or privacy on this website, you can contact us at sharkhumanalliance@gmail.com.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This page explains how Shark Human Alliance processes personal data when you order a certificate, receive emails, appear in the public registry or use analytics cookies. It is written for an international audience, and our contractual and privacy communication is generally provided in English and Spanish. It is intended to cover the core information required by Article 13 GDPR and related privacy laws.

controller.title: 1. Controller and contact
controller.body:
The controller for Shark Human Alliance is JEEL Wekeza s.r.o., with its registered office at Radlicka 663/28, Smichov, 150 00 Prague 5, Czech Republic, company ID 07969694. Legal form: limited liability company.

Primary privacy contact: sharkhumanalliance@gmail.com.

No separate data protection officer is currently published for this service.

dataCategories.title: 2. Which data we process
dataCategories.body:
Depending on how you use the service, we may process: certificate name, dedication text, email address, order and payment metadata, referral code and referral activity, public registry visibility preference, access token and verification identifiers, basic technical metadata such as IP address used for security and rate limiting, and cookie preference data.

Payment card details are not stored by Shark Human Alliance. Payments are handled by Stripe under Stripe's own systems and notices.

legalBases.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases

publicRegistry.title: 4. Public registry and certificate visibility
publicRegistry.body:
Registry publication is optional. New purchases are shown in the public registry only if the buyer enables that option during checkout.

Records can later be hidden from the public registry or anonymized through the certificate access controls or by contacting support. Verification pages for non-public or erased records are not shown publicly.

providers.title: 5. Service providers and recipients
providers.body:
To operate the website, checkout and certificate delivery, we may share relevant data with providers that support the service, including Stripe for payments, Resend for email delivery, Vercel for hosting and application delivery, and the PostgreSQL database provider used for the project environment, such as Neon or Supabase.

These providers receive only the data needed for their role in operating the service.

transfers.title: 6. International transfers
transfers.body: Some providers used by the service may process data outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Where such transfers occur, we rely on the provider's applicable transfer mechanism, such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, adequacy decisions or equivalent safeguards made available by the provider.

retention.title: 7. Retention periods
retention.body:
We keep certificate and order data for as long as needed to operate the service, demonstrate the transaction and handle support, legal or accounting obligations. Public registry visibility remains active until the record is hidden or erased. Cookie preference data is stored for up to 180 days unless changed earlier.

Where the law requires longer retention for accounting or tax records, those records may be kept for the required statutory period.

rights.title: 8. Your rights
rights.body:
Subject to applicable law, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, withdrawal of consent, objection to certain processing and the right to lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority. Because the controller is established in the Czech Republic, the relevant authority for the controller is the Office for Personal Data Protection (UOOU), while data subjects in the EU may also have the right to complain to the authority in their place of residence, work or the place of the alleged infringement.

If a request concerns a public registry entry, please include the registry ID, referral code or certificate access link where possible.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and analytics
cookies.body:
Necessary cookies are used for core website functions, checkout flow, language handling, security and storing your cookie preference. Google Analytics 4 may be initialized on the site with a restrictive default consent mode so we can operate the analytics setup, but analytics storage remains denied until analytics consent is granted. If you reject analytics cookies, analytics storage stays denied.

For more detail, see our Cookie Policy and the cookie settings control in the footer.

contact.title: 10. How to exercise your rights
contact.body:
Email privacy requests and complaints to sharkhumanalliance@gmail.com. If your request concerns a specific certificate, include enough information for us to identify the record safely, such as the certificate email address, registry ID or certificate access link.

If you believe we have not handled your request properly, you may also contact the competent supervisory authority. For the controller, that authority is the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (UOOU).
